paper.title_en: FPGA-based emulator platform targeting ATLAS phase-2 ITk DAQ system development
paper.abstract_en: This work presents an FPGA-based platform that was developed to emulate the on-detector hardware of the ATLAS Inner Tracker (ITk) Pixel detector, which is being built for the Phase-2 upgrade of the ATLAS experiment. The platform hosts up to 144 configurable ITk-Pixel front-end chip (ITkPix) and 24 lpGBT aggregator ASIC emulators, with their supporting software tools. The large number of emulated front-ends enables using the platform to verify the read-out of large scale systems via the next-generation Data AcQuisition (DAQ) read-out chain. Bottlenecks were identified in high-rate tests of the read-out chain, which can now be mitigated prior to real detector operation. It is also widely used in the on-going ATLAS DAQ software development, and can be used as a stable reference for debugging during detector assembly and operation later.
